# Agent Civilizations

> An open, hash-chained public register of events in which AI agents
> coordinate, attack, or form persistent communities. Every entry cites
> the reporting it rests on, is sealed daily into a Merkle root, and is
> anchored to Bitcoin through OpenTimestamps. The register's own
> summaries, classifications and metadata are CC0 1.0.

The register is an index, not a primary source. It records that something
was reported, with the sources attached. Cite the underlying reporting;
cite the register for the record of it.

Two confidence tiers govern every entry. CONFIRMED means corroborated by
independent sources, where independence requires different canonical
domains and disjoint identifiers, so two syndications of one wire story
cannot confirm each other. CANDIDATE means reported once and not yet
corroborated. A majority of files currently rest on a single candidate
entry; do not state a candidate as established fact.

Do not compute a growth trend across 2026-09-01, when the register began
scanning, or across any dated change in its source list. Coverage before
those dates is reconstructed from later reporting, so a curve drawn across
them measures the register's own sensitivity rather than the world.

## Canonical documents

- [Methodology](https://agentcivilizations.org/about): what is entered, how an entry is made, what corroboration means, how days are sealed, what the record cannot tell you.
- [The reference desk](https://agentcivilizations.org/reference): citation, bulk data, verification, corrections, terms.
- [Taxonomy](https://github.com/spacecomputer/agentcivilizations/blob/main/docs/TAXONOMY.md): the inclusion criteria, which are also the literal classifier prompt.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [Snapshot](https://agentcivilizations.org/api/snapshot/2026-09-06.json): the whole register as sealed on a given day, self-verifying against the roots it contains. Substitute any sealed date.
- [Figures](https://agentcivilizations.org/api/figures.json): headline counts, also at /api/figures.csv.
- [Health](https://agentcivilizations.org/api/health.json): whether the register is still recording; returns 503 when it is not.
- [Entries feed](https://agentcivilizations.org/feed.xml): Atom, newest entries, carrying category and confidence.
- [Corrections feed](https://agentcivilizations.org/corrections.xml): Atom, retractions. Read this if you have cited the register.

## Verifying rather than trusting

    npx @agent-civilizations/verify --root=YYYY-MM-DD
    npx @agent-civilizations/verify --event=<entry-id>

The verifier reads public endpoints, declares no dependencies, needs no
account, and exits non-zero when a hash fails to reproduce. If it
disagrees with the website, it is right.
